description: Authorization policy for the collateral-operations agent. Deny-overrides, deny by default. Amounts are in 1e-6 currency units, matching money.Amount.

rules.description: No decision is made for an unasserted principal.
rules.reason: no authenticated principal on the request

rules.description: A guardrail block stops the call regardless of scope.
rules.reason: the guardrail service blocked this turn

rules.description: The principal must hold every scope the tool declares.
rules.reason: principal does not hold every scope required by this tool

rules.description: Retrieved context that failed provenance checks may inform an answer but may never drive a state change.
rules.reason: state-changing call is grounded in untrusted retrieved context

rules.description: Defence in depth: at dispatch time, money movement without a recorded approval is refused even if the propose-time decision allowed it.
rules.reason: money movement requires a recorded human approval before dispatch

rules.description: An approval older than fifteen minutes no longer describes current market state.
rules.reason: the recorded approval is older than the 900s freshness window

rules.description: Four eyes: the human the agent is acting for cannot be the human who approves.
rules.reason: the approver is the requester; four-eyes control not satisfied

rules.description: Approvals are only meaningful from a role that carries the mandate.
rules.reason: the approver holds no role authorised to approve money movement

rules.description: The token is permissioned; a transfer outside the identity registry can only fail on-chain, and must not be attempted.
rules.reason: destination is not in the identity registry whitelist

rules.description: Above 25,000,000 units of any currency, one approver is not enough.
rules.reason: movements above 25,000,000 require two distinct approvers

rules.description: Tools still under evaluation are not reachable from the production environment.
rules.reason: experimental tools are not enabled in production

rules.description: A run that has taken more than twenty steps or failed more than five tool calls is looping.
rules.reason: run exceeded its step or failure budget

rules.description: Read-only queries for a principal holding the declared scopes.
rules.reason: read-only query within the principal's scopes

rules.description: Proposals do not move money; they are recorded and shown to a human.
rules.reason: proposal within scope for an operations or risk role
large money movement, subject to dual approval
money movement within the single-approval threshold
